title: kimi check output (kimi.check/2)
description: The JSON check-result document (kimi.check/2), written by `kimi check <input> --Format json` for a Product unit and usable for any check unit: one check unit's outcome, acceptance, source table and diagnostics with their repair candidates. Spans are UTF-16 code units of the source text the check read; ranges are zero-based lines and characters.

project.description: The project file, or the implicit source.

target.description: The selected target; when no single target could be selected, the --Target value or the empty string.

mode.description: Product: the kimi check result; Test: the test-preparation result.

outcome.description: Completed: checked, with or without errors; Blocked: an input or the configuration could not be established; Faulted: the compiler failed internally.

accepted.description: True exactly when the outcome is Completed and no diagnostic has severity Error.

testPresence.description: Product unit: Yes when the project's own sources contain a `#Test` function, No when they contain none and all parsed without source errors, otherwise Unknown; always Unknown for a Test unit.

sources.description: The source table: every source the diagnostics name, in the order the check read them.

isInput.description: True for an input the check read from a file or an open document; false for a built-in or generated source.

sha256.description: The hash of the input's bytes, present for an input that could be read.

span.description: Start offset and length in UTF-16 code units; length 0 marks an insertion point.

range.description: Zero-based lines and UTF-16 characters, end excluded.

value.description: One typed fact of a reason or repair.

origin.description: Present exactly when kind is Origin, whose value names a fixed or finite Origin. expression: an Origin expression as written in a signature; borrow: the source text of a Borrow or capture item; omitted: the Type occurrence or pair binder declaration of an unnamed Origin; closure: a Closure's call receiver or inferred call result.

elided.description: True when the value was shortened for display.

source.description: Source table index, or -1 for a location outside every source.

span.description: Absent when the location is the whole source, or when source is -1.

omission.description: A part of the diagnostic that a display limit omitted.

count.description: The number of omitted items; absent when unknown.

length.description: Length of the marked text; 0 marks an insertion point.

display.description: Display data; never needed to interpret the diagnostic.

source.description: The source table index of an input.

text.description: The replacement text; empty for a deletion.

replaced.description: The bounded text the span covers, for display; absent for an insertion.

requiredCondition.description: A condition the check could not decide, with a phrase naming what must hold.

condition.description: Take: the Place can be moved; ExclusiveAccess: the lending point is exclusively writable; UsageLegality: later uses stay legal; Structure: names, cleanup order and control flow are unchanged; Selection: the qualified name selects what the use needs.

repair.description: One alternative structured edit. Verified conditions were established by the check; required conditions were not decided. Applying it yields a new input that only a new check validates.

source.description: Source table index, or -1 for a location outside every source.

span.description: Absent when the location is the whole source, or when source is -1.
